name: TotalEnergies
notes: Revenue = 'Sales' (top line, includes excise taxes). No operating income / pre-tax subtotal under IFRS: operatingIncome = pre-tax income DERIVED as 'Consolidated net income' + 'Income taxes' (both reported lines; includes after-tax equity-affiliate income). Same derivation applied to French GAAP years 2001-2003 for consistency. EUR reporting through FY2012 results; USD from FY2014 results onward with 2013 restated in USD (2013 anchor is the USD restatement). 2004 is IFRS pre-Arkema restatement; 2005 restated ex-Arkema. 2016+ from SEC XBRL financial report (R2) pages. FY ends Dec 31.
